name: lazy-trader-agent
description: The lazy trader: a Yeetful payer agent with funds on the WRONG chain. Give it a goal ('have 2 USDC on Arbitrum, then supply it to Aave') — it pays x402 for Yeetful's fund_and_build runbook, signs the cross-chain legs with its own key, and completes the goal. Dry-run by default.
